prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production-style glyph sprite atlas for a small animated lettering design study, not a font file.
Input image 1: existing neutral production Relay! word is the letter-shape reference. Preserve its broad faceted crystal R, lowercase e, slender l, a and descending y, and diamond-dot exclamation. Input image 2: approved numerals-and-light concept is the opalescent material and digit-shape reference.
Primary request: produce exactly TEN separate, front-facing, upright glyphs arranged in a STRICT 5-column by 2-row equal-cell grid. Top row left-to-right exactly R e l a y. Bottom row left-to-right exactly ! + 1 2 8. Each glyph must be independently isolated and fully inside its own cell with at least 15% clear transparent padding to all cell edges. Each glyph centered in its cell. No touching, no ligatures, no connected words. One glyph per cell only. The exact characters are case-sensitive: uppercase R then lowercase e l a y. The l is a lowercase ascender, not an uppercase I. y has its descending curved terminal.
Style: one coherent bespoke Crystal Comet family, 70% broad carved facets, 20% gentle comet gesture, 10% luminous warmth. Match existing artwork's friendly angular silhouettes, slightly flowing serifs, very open counters and crisp broad facets. Shared front camera, cap-height scale and lighting for every glyph. Letter faces mostly pearl with clearly visible lavender, ice-blue, peach and blush facets; shallow plum edges. Broad calm opalescence and bright cut edges, not dense cracks, rough stone or uniformly white washed-out faces. Make these appear like the same material as the approved pearl numeral specimens.
All views are FRONT views, with no rotation or skew. No added extrusion beyond the reference's shallow illustrated bevel; the prototype will supply geometric depth separately. Transparent exterior and transparent holes/counters. No external stars, sparkles, flares, shadows or glow outside the glyph boundaries. No background, checkerboard, labels, rules, cell lines, titles or watermark.
Prefer a landscape 3:2 image with two rows of tall glyph cells. Keep the ten characters exactly in the requested order. The plus is a plus sign, not a star. The exclamation has a separate diamond-shaped dot.
notes: Unchanged generated PNG. Alpha-derived contours and fixed registration isolate the ten glyphs for both treatments. Candidate edges are deterministic shallow geometry; front artwork stays shared.
